name: Who Stole My Beer?
description: Give the Lighthouse Keeper a Beer, use the returned Empty Beer Can for Spider Crab and bring the required result back for the boat key.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the Lighthouse starting area

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Buy a Beer and give it to the Lighthouse Keeper.
Equip the returned Empty Beer Can on the Crab Fishing Rod.
Defeat Spider Crab and keep the quest result.
Return it to the keeper for the boat key, then buy the $10 Radar.

sections.heading: Common blocker
paragraphs: The kill alone does not complete the route. Pick up the correct quest result and finish the return dialogue before expecting the next coordinates.

name: Dinnertime & the Leech Route
description: Complete the lady's request, collect three ground leeches and turn the resulting Leech Bait into the Giant Piranha trophy.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the Forest Island route

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Speak to the lady by the lake and complete the active dinner request.
Pick up three leeches from the island ground.
Trade them for Leech Bait.
Defeat Giant Piranha, then return its named trophy for Desert Island coordinates.

sections.heading: Spawn warning
paragraphs: Leeches are ground pickups rather than ordinary fish-table catches. If too few appear, revisit dialogue and reload the island instead of wasting a lure in the water.

name: Vacation & Pufferfish Route
description: Trade an eligible endangered creature for a Carrot, defeat Pufferfish and return the fin for Rocks Island coordinates.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the Pufferfish boss battle

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Catch an eligible endangered creature with the Standard Lure; Needlefish and Seahorse are confirmed options.
Give the eligible catch to the tourist under the tree for a Carrot.
Use the Carrot to summon Pufferfish.
Return the Pufferfish fin to unlock Rocks Island.

sections.heading: Achievement check
paragraphs: Vacation is tied to the Desert Tourist chain. Complete the NPC return dialogue after the Pufferfish objective before leaving the island.

name: Grillmaster & Blue Shark
description: Use the $280 Standard Boss Lure, bring Blue Shark to the Grillmaster and unlock the 1.5× cooking route.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of players using an island grill

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Buy Standard Boss Lure for $280.
Summon and defeat Blue Shark.
Bring the body to the Grillmaster.
Start the grill to unlock the achievement and cooking loop.

sections.heading: Cooking rule
paragraphs: Cooking can raise the inspected item value to about 1.5×. Pull it away at the peak: once an item burns black, its value drops to zero.

name: Terrorizing Bird
description: Turn a Professional Boss Lure into Tuna, use the body as Albatross bait and return the bird's head for Volcano coordinates.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot showing a bird above an island

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Buy Professional Boss Lure for $1,200.
Defeat Tuna and keep the body.
Place it on the ground to draw in Albatross.
Defeat the bird and return its head for Volcano coordinates.

sections.heading: Common blocker
paragraphs: Do not sell, cook or consume the Tuna before the second encounter. It is a physical trigger item, not just a completed encyclopedia entry.

name: Deadliest Catch Military Route
description: Complete the military preparation on Volcano Island before the final Boss-type Bowhead encounter and keep its achievement trigger separate from the Scientist's bait chain.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of late-game equipment used on Volcano Island
sourceLabel: Achievement code + unpacked NPC quest mapping

sections.heading: Quest steps
bullets: Speak to the Volcano military officer before starting the final encounter chain.
Complete the active military objective and return to the same quest giver when its dialogue updates.
Prepare a strong firearm and enough money for late-game supplies before committing to the whale sequence.
Continue with the Scientist's Whale Bait route; the Deadliest Catch achievement check runs on the final Boss-type whale death.

sections.heading: What this quest does not do
paragraphs: The military quest and the Scientist's bait quest are separate NPC records in the game data. Finishing military dialogue does not replace the smaller-catch hand-ins needed to make Whale Bait.

name: Scientist's Whale Bait & Final Route
description: Bring the Scientist the requested smaller catches, receive Fish Bucket / Whale Bait, keep the Bowhead body and carry it into the Volcano trigger for the final fight.
imageAlt: In-game How to Fish Mutated Bowhead Whale final encounter
sourceLabel: Unpacked Whale NPC quest mapping + final-route cross-check

sections.heading: Quest steps
bullets: Speak to the Scientist and read the current requested-catch list before fishing; the exact hand-in must match the active quest state.
Return all requested smaller catches to receive the Fish Bucket used as Whale Bait.
Use the Fish Bucket to catch Bowhead Whale, then keep the defeated body instead of selling, cooking or discarding it.
Carry the Bowhead body into the Volcano trigger and defeat Mutated Bowhead Whale.
Take the final transport after the fight to trigger the finish-game check and ending achievement.

sections.heading: Before the final fight
paragraphs: The final boss death and the ending transport are separate checkpoints. Handyman also checks only the finishing hit, so lower the boss normally and reserve a bare-fist-strength hit under 5 damage for the last blow.
